prompt: Create an original 90 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 68 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A gentle and melancholic piano melody is accompanied by a lush string section, creating a reflective and serene atmosphere. The piece features a slow tempo and a rich, harmonious arrangement.
description.zh: 一段轻柔而忧郁的钢琴旋律，伴随着华丽的弦乐部分，营造出一种沉思而宁静的氛围。这首曲子节奏缓慢，编排丰富和谐。
